parameters.query:
SELECT 
  t.id AS task_id, 
  t.title AS task_title, 
  t.required_skills,
  m.id AS member_id, 
  m.full_name AS member_name, 
  m.skills AS member_skills
FROM tasks t
CROSS JOIN members m
WHERE t.assignee_id IS NULL AND array_length(t.required_skills, 1) > 0;

UPDATE tasks 
SET assignee_id = '{{ $json.best_member_id }}', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = '{{ $json.task_id }}'
RETURNING id, title, assignee_id;
